result.title: Is spectral predictability enough? Testing Ω-matching for synthetic pretraining under distribution shift
result.summary: Synthetic pretraining under distribution shift requires deciding what synthetic data to use. A natural criterion is to match the spectral predictability $Ω$ of the source to the target, but is $Ω$ sufficient? We test this hypothesis, which we call predictability-aware pretraining, across three architectures (LSTM, PatchTST, TCN) and three seeds. Under ideal synthetic-to-synthetic conditions, $Ω$-matched pretraining can outperform even an oracle baseline (+46.8% MSE reduction, LSTM), though the benefit is already architecture-dependent. On the real-world ETTm1 benchmark, however, this relationship does not hold: sine-plus-noise pretraining at matched $Ω$ yields only a marginal mean improvement +2.3% averaged over all three architectures, up to +65.5% on individual channels), whereas $Ω$ matched chaotic ODE trajectories systematically degrade performance -13.2%). The two sources agree on the direction of transfer for only 53% of configurations across all three architectures (Pearson r=-0.02), indicating that $Ω$ carries little information about which source will transfer beneficially. We further observe an architecture-dependent asymmetry in the response to the direction of the $Ω$ gap. We conclude that $Ω$ matching can help in controlled settings but is not sufficient to predict transfer across sources, and we discuss additional signal properties that a source-selection criterion may need to consider.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 LSTM、PatchTST、TCN 三种时序架构上进行合成预训练实验，检验「谱可预测性 Ω 匹配」能否作为选择合成数据来源的准则；结果显示在受控的合成到合成设定下 Ω 匹配有效，但在真实基准 ETTm1 上 Ω 与迁移收益几乎不相关（两来源迁移方向一致率仅 53%）。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其核心问题——单一谱统计量能否预测某数据来源是否带来迁移收益——可供核查：类似地，latent 轨迹的可预测性或谱特征是否足以预测推理训练收益、单指标筛选证据或轨迹是否易失效，可能提供借鉴。
